name: NEON GULCH
intro: Build speed downhill. Boost the gold runways, steer the flight, then spend that speed on the next line.

qualifier.targetBasis: A deterministic clean no-boost line runs about 59.8 seconds. Gold at 66 seconds rewards an optimized line, Silver at 72 allows a modest correction, and the 80-second qualifying deadline leaves about twenty seconds for learning the dirt and elevation changes.

design.focus: Manage downhill momentum across visible crests, loose dirt, and medium-speed direction changes while repeating a boost-to-airbrake rhythm.
design.surfacePlan: Asphalt runways build and recover speed; two compact dirt descents trade grip for a straighter safe line; seven elevation changes make crests and landings readable without hiding the next required response.

cycles.summary: A long opening read teaches the right-lane launch, a gentle cone sweep, and a directly visible left-side rock closure.
cycles.flow: read -> bank boost -> broad ramp -> neutral flight -> right-to-center cone payoff -> airbrake right around visible rocks -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Stay center, skip the cone sweep, and pass the left-side rocks on the open right half.
cycles.committedLine: Take the right boost and ramp, then sweep four objective cones before returning right for the rock closure.

cycles.summary: A downhill right-lane jump carries speed into the first committed bend and an open-left rock response.
cycles.flow: downhill read -> right boost -> ramp over same-lane rocks -> long flight -> cone transfer -> airbrake left through the sweeper -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Ignore the right runway and set up early in the open left lane for the sweeper.
cycles.committedLine: Clear the right-lane rocks in the air, collect the descending cone line, then use the left airbrake to hold the open exit.

cycles.summary: The first dirt beat slows the pulse before a left-lane launch, centerward cone landing, and clean asphalt chicane.
cycles.flow: dirt read -> left boost -> dirt ramp -> glide toward center -> cone payoff -> asphalt chicane precision -> long breathe
cycles.safeLine: Hold center through the dirt and skip the outside ramp before taking the chicane at ordinary speed.
cycles.committedLine: Carry the left boost through loose grip, launch, and glide centerward through the cone chain before the chicane.

cycles.summary: Two separated crest launches form the signature call-and-response beat, followed by a leftward cone setup and the course's strongest paved sweeper.
cycles.flow: climb read -> left boost and rock-clear ramp -> recover -> center boost and ramp -> settle -> cone transfer -> airbrake sweeper -> broad breathe
cycles.safeLine: Climb on the right half, bypass both launch lanes, and enter the sweeper below overspeed.
cycles.committedLine: Clear the first crest rocks, re-center during the ordinary-flight recovery, then take the second boost-ramp and its leftward cone payoff.

cycles.summary: A second dirt descent asks for a right-lane launch, a cone transfer toward center, then a deliberate return right around visible curve-side rocks.
cycles.flow: dirt read -> right boost -> dirt ramp -> controlled flight -> cone transfer -> airbrake back right past rocks -> asphalt release
cycles.safeLine: Keep a modest center-right line through the dirt and approach the open rock lane without launching.
cycles.committedLine: Boost off the right dirt ramp, sweep toward center for every cone, then airbrake back to the open right lane.

cycles.summary: The technical climax fires a boosted downhill rock-clear into a cone chain that hands directly to the strongest chicane, then gives a full straight to recover.
cycles.flow: downhill reveal -> right boost -> rock-clear ramp -> long landing -> cone chain -> linked airbrake chicane -> extended breathe
cycles.safeLine: Stay left of the runway and enter the chicane at stable speed with the entire road available.
cycles.committedLine: Launch right over the rocks, collect the right-to-center cone chain, and preserve speed by airbraking through both chicane halves.

cycles.summary: The finale rebuilds speed through a visible curve exit, a last right-lane rock-clear, an objective sweep, a center gap on the home climb, and clean finish road.
cycles.flow: curve reveal -> right boost -> final ramp -> rewarding flight -> cone sweep -> center-line rock gap -> climb -> rival-safe finish sprint
cycles.safeLine: Exit the curve center-left, skip the ramp, and align with the obvious center gap before the home climb.
cycles.committedLine: Take the right boost and final rock-clear, collect the straight cone sweep, then airbrake to the center gap without surrendering the finish sprint.
